description: This file defines the AccountRepository interface in a Java Spring application, which extends CrudRepository to perform CRUD operations on Account entities and includes a custom method to find accounts by account number.

classes.name: AccountRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data repository interface for Account entities with a custom find method.

methods.name: findByAccountNumber
methods.description: Retrieves an Account entity based on the account number, returning an Optional<Account>.
